entries.chinese:
一个美丽但高傲的地底精灵，有着魔法天赋，但除此之外，就没什么了。
他的技能是对他的双胞胎妹妹杜维莎的格斗技能的完美补充。
为寻求更强大的魔法，他和他的妹妹一起前往地表。
entries.english:
A beautiful but vain deep elf with an aptitude for magic and little else. His
skills are the perfect complement of his twin sister Duvessa's fighting prowess.
In search of more powerful spells, he journeys to the surface with his sister.

entries.chinese: 训练成本（以<cyan>青色</cyan>显示）表示将指定技能提升一级所需的相对经验值，以资质为零的技能从零级升到一级所需的经验值为基准。
entries.english: The training cost (in <cyan>cyan</cyan>) shows the experience cost to raise the given skill one level, relative to the cost of raising an aptitude zero skill from level zero to level one.
entries.key: The training cost (in <cyan>cyan</cyan>) shows the experience cost to raise the given skill one level, relative to the cost of raising an aptitude zero skill from level zero to level one.

entries.chinese:
一个由纯净的活水晶生成的多刺、长鼻啮齿动物。它免疫大多数形式的魔法，
既能射击使目标结晶，也能投掷令人剧痛的倒刺。
entries.english:
A spiny, long snouted rodent grown out of pure living crystal. It is
immune to most forms of magic and hurls both crystallising shots and painful
barbs.

entries.chinese:
有倒刺扎入你的皮肤，移动时会受到伤害。
在原地停留片刻，就能移除这些倒刺而不受伤害。
entries.english:
There are barbs embedded in your skin, and moving around will cause you to take
damage. Remaining in place for a short time will allow you to remove the barbs
without taking damage.

entries.chinese: 尖刺
entries.english: Barbs

entries.chinese: 你陷入了迷魂状态。
entries.english: You are mesmerised.

entries.chinese:
尝试迷住视野内所有敌人。未能抵抗的冒险者会无法远离施法者，
其他生物则会直接陷入眩晕。

离开施法者视野会结束控制移动的效果。
entries.english:
Attempts to entrance all enemies in sight. Adventurers who fail to resist will
become unable to move away from the caster, while other creatures will become
dazed outright.

Leaving the caster's line of sight will end the movement-controlling effect.

entries.chinese:
用邪恶能量压倒敌人，不可抗拒地削弱其近战攻击并降低法术威力。
它还会使无法抵抗全部诅咒力量的敌人眩晕和失明，
即使目标没有视觉感官也不例外。
entries.english:
Overwhelms an enemy with malignant energies, irresistibly weakening their melee
attacks and reducing the power of their spells. It will additionally daze and
blind any foe that fails to resist the full force of the curse - even those
without visual senses!

entries.chinese:
你正驱使所有护甲喧闹地攻击。你附身的每件护甲都会自主行动；
它们受到的任何伤害都不会影响你，你也可以自由地穿过它们射击。
它们的攻击可能使敌人眩晕、陷入衰竭，或使其陷入混乱。
entries.english:
You are noisily attacking with all of your armour. Every piece of armour you
haunt currently moves of its own volition; any damage it takes will not affect
you, you can freely fire through it, and its attacks may daze, drain, or confuse
your enemies.

entries.chinese:
一种快速生长的蘑菇，其生命周期以孢子的爆发性释放为高潮。
这些孢子具有轻微的致幻效果，有时会使吸入它们的生物眩晕。
entries.english:
A rapidly-growing mushroom whose life-cycle culminates in an explosive release
of spores. These spores have a mild psychoactive effect and can sometimes daze
creatures who breathe them in.

entries.chinese: 这个生物暂时无法行动，但任何敌对行为将使其立即恢复神智。
entries.english:
This creature is temporarily unable to act, but any hostile action will cause it to
immediately regain its senses.

entries.chinese: 你深受迷魂影响，无法狂暴。
entries.english: You are too mesmerised to rage.
entries.key: You are too mesmerised to rage.

selector_keys: You are too mesmerised to rage.

entries.chinese: 眩晕
entries.english: dazed

entries.chinese:
唱出萦绕心头的歌，迷住附近听众。未能抵抗的冒险者会无法远离歌者，
其他生物则会直接陷入眩晕。

离开施法者视野会结束控制移动的效果。
entries.english:
Sings a haunting song that mesmerises nearby listeners. Adventurers who fail to
resist will become unable to move away from the singer, while other creatures
will become dazed outright.

Leaving the caster's line of sight will end the movement-controlling effect.

entries.chinese:
唱出一首极具魔力、萦绕心头的歌。未能抵抗的冒险者会无法远离歌者
（有时还会不由自主地被拉近），其他生物则会直接陷入眩晕。

此外，它可能从附近的任何深水中召来溺魂。

离开施法者视野会结束控制移动的效果。
entries.english:
Sings a powerfully haunting song. Adventurers who fail to resist will become
unable to move away from the singer (and will sometimes be drawn closer
involuntarily), while other creatures will become dazed outright.

In addition, it may call forth drowned souls from any nearby bodies of deep
water.

Leaving the caster's line of sight will end the movement-controlling effect.

entries.chinese: 毒烟
entries.english: noxious fumes

entries.chinese: 毒气
entries.english: poison gas

entries.chinese:
一团呛人又有毒的云。
任何生物身处其中，除非具有毒抗，否则都有陷入混乱的危险。
越坚韧、经验等级越高的生物不太会受此影响。
entries.english:
A cloud of vile, choking fumes. Any creature spending time in it will be at
risk of becoming confused by the gases, unless resistant to poison. Tougher,
more experienced creatures are less likely to be affected.

entries.chinese: 一团有着致命毒性的云。任何没有毒抗的生物，在里面就会中毒并直接受到伤害。
entries.english:
A cloud of deadly poison. Any creature without resistance to poison will be
both poisoned and directly harmed by time spent in it.

entries.chinese:
召出一个脆弱的瓶子，瓶子爆炸后形成短暂存在的毒烟云。
这些云可能使任何没有毒抗的生物陷入混乱。
越坚韧、经验越丰富的生物越不容易受影响。
entries.english:
Conjures a fragile flask that explodes into short-lived clouds of noxious fumes.
These clouds may cause confusion in any creature not resistant to poison.
Tougher, more experienced creatures are less likely to be affected.

entries.chinese: 产生一大片毒烟云，可能引起混乱。
entries.english: Creates a large cloud of noxious fumes, which may cause confusion.

entries.chinese:
施放迷瘴云时，毒烟会覆盖一片区域；瞄准时，你会看到它影响的范围。
设法将多个敌人笼罩在同一片云中，以更有效地利用你的魔法。
entries.english:
Mephitic Cloud covers an area in noxious fumes when cast, and you'll be able to
see the area it affects as you target it. Try to catch multiple enemies in a
single cloud in order to be more efficient with your magic.

entries.english: A donation of $%d equates to an increase of piety by %d.
entries.key: A donation of $%d equates to an increase of piety by %d.

selector_keys: A donation of $%d equates to an increase of piety by %d.

entries.chinese: 你感到自己的虔诚值降低了。
entries.english: You feel less pious.

selector_keys: To the devout, Zin provideth. From the rest...

entries.chinese: 虔诚者
entries.english: Pious

entries.chinese: 达到了
entries.english: Reached

entries.chinese: 虔诚等级，信仰
entries.english: piety under

entries.chinese: 视野内有敌对怪物时使用祈神能力，偶尔会召唤一条龙。触发几率为10% + 所使用能力的虔诚值消耗的两倍。
entries.english: It occasionally summons a dragon when using Invocations with hostile monsters in sight. Chance is 10% + twice the piety cost of the ability used.
entries.key: It occasionally summons a dragon when using Invocations with hostile monsters in sight. Chance is 10% + twice the piety cost of the ability used.

selector_keys: It occasionally summons a dragon when using Invocations with hostile monsters in sight. Chance is 10% + twice the piety cost of the ability used.
It occasionally summons a dragon when using divine abilities with hostile monsters in sight. Chance is 10% + twice the piety cost of the ability used.

entries.chinese: 这个传送器设有禁区标记！
entries.english: This transporter is marked as excluded!
entries.key: This transporter is marked as excluded!

selector_keys: This transporter is marked as excluded!

entries.chinese: 这个%s%s设有禁区标记！仍要打开它吗？
entries.english: This %s%s is marked as excluded! Open it anyway?
entries.key: This %s%s is marked as excluded! Open it anyway?

selector_keys: This %s%s is marked as excluded! Open it anyway?

entries.chinese: \n为避免在旅行或自动探索时意外打开你希望保持关闭的门，你可以在光标位于该格时，从地图视图（<w>X</w>）中按<w>ee</w>将其标记为旅行禁区。此禁区标记会阻止自动旅行进入该格，直到你再次按<w>Xe</w>将其移除。
entries.english: \nTo avoid accidentally opening a door you'd rather remain closed during travel or autoexplore, you can mark it with an exclusion from the map view (<w>X</w>) with <w>ee</w> while your cursor is on the grid in question. Such an exclusion will prevent autotravel from ever entering that grid until you remove the exclusion with another press of <w>Xe</w>.
entries.key: \nTo avoid accidentally opening a door you'd rather remain closed during travel or autoexplore, you can mark it with an exclusion from the map view (<w>X</w>) with <w>ee</w> while your cursor is on the grid in question. Such an exclusion will prevent autotravel from ever entering that grid until you remove the exclusion with another press of <w>Xe</w>.

selector_keys: \nTo avoid accidentally opening a door you'd rather remain closed during travel or autoexplore, you can mark it with an exclusion from the map view (<w>X</w>) with <w>ee</w> while your cursor is on the grid in question. Such an exclusion will prevent autotravel from ever entering that grid until you remove the exclusion with another press of <w>Xe</w>.

entries.chinese: \n为避免在旅行或自动探索时意外打开你希望保持关闭的门，你可以在光标位于该格时，从地图视图（<w>X</w>）中按<w>ee</w>将其标记为旅行禁区。此禁区标记会阻止自动旅行进入该格，直到你再次按<w>Xe</w>将其移除。
entries.english: \nTo avoid accidentally opening a door you'd rather remain closed during travel or autoexplore, you can mark it with an exclusion from the map view (<w>X</w>) with <w>ee</w> while your cursor is on the grid in question. Such an exclusion will prevent autotravel from ever entering that grid until you remove the exclusion with another press of <w>Xe</w>.

entries.chinese: 为避免在旅行或自动探索时意外打开你希望保持关闭的门，你可以进入地图视图（<w>$cmd[CMD_DISPLAY_MAP]</w>），将光标移到该格上，按 <w>$cmd[CMD_MAP_EXCLUDE_AREA]$cmd[CMD_MAP_EXCLUDE_AREA]</w> 将其标记为禁区。此禁区会阻止自动旅行进入该格，直到你再次按 <w>$cmd[CMD_DISPLAY_MAP]$cmd[CMD_MAP_EXCLUDE_AREA]</w> 将其移除。
entries.english:
To avoid accidentally opening a door you'd rather remain closed during travel
or autoexplore, you can mark it with an exclusion from the map view
(<w>$cmd[CMD_DISPLAY_MAP]</w>) with
<w>$cmd[CMD_MAP_EXCLUDE_AREA]$cmd[CMD_MAP_EXCLUDE_AREA]</w> while your cursor
is on the square in question. Such an exclusion will prevent autotravel from
ever entering that grid until you remove the exclusion with another press of
<w>$cmd[CMD_DISPLAY_MAP]$cmd[CMD_MAP_EXCLUDE_AREA]</w>.
